benefit.name: Calgary Fair Entry — Transit & Recreation
benefit.amount: Transit pass $6.30–$63/month by income band + lower-cost recreation
benefit.summary: One application gets you a low-income monthly transit pass and lower-cost City of Calgary pools, fitness and recreation programs.
benefit.note: Apply once through Fair Entry. The transit pass has three 2026 income bands: $6.30, $44.10 or $63.00 per month.

detail.about: A single City of Calgary application ('Fair Entry') that qualifies you for several low-income discounts at once — the sliding-scale monthly transit pass and lower-cost recreation admission and programs. Calgary does not publish a fixed percentage for recreation fee assistance.
steps: Gather proof of income for your household.
Apply online through Fair Entry (or in person).
Once approved, buy the low-income transit pass and use your Fee Assistance card for recreation.
documents: Proof of income (e.g. tax assessment or benefit statements)
tips: One approval covers transit and recreation. You do not apply separately.
The transit pass price changes with income. There are three 2026 bands: $6.30, $44.10 or $63.00 per month.
detail.time: Usually processed within a couple of weeks.

values.note: transit $6.30–$63/mo by income band + lower-cost recreation
